[p align="justify"]These path experience and balance improvements are based on real-time data and player feedback. While ensuring the stability of the path experience, we have focused our adjustments on paths whose data performance fell short of expectations and where gameplay experience still had room for improvement. At the same time, we have targeted core pain points that Wanderers heavily reported as significantly affecting the experience, alongside adjusting the balance of certain gameplay modes.

[p align="justify"]We invite you to keep sharing your thoughts with us. We are listening closely and will continue to refine the development, paths, and competitive gameplay and balance with care in future versions.
Progression Optimization

[p align="justify"]1. Added the \[Modulated Gear Recovery] feature to reduce negative experiences caused by accidental operations. All fully tuned Legendary gear can be recovered within 7 days after being consumed as Modulating materials. Upon recovery, all recycled materials and Modulating Stones must be returned. Optimized the \[Gear Recovery] experience by adding a source filter option in the Gear Recovery interface, allowing you to separately filter gear that was recycled, consumed via Tuning, or consumed via Modulating.

[p align="justify"]2. Added the \[Free Unlocked Set Switching] feature to increase the flexibility of set switching. After this version update, the initial set on each piece of gear, as well as any sets previously switched to on that gear, will be permanently unlocked (sets replaced before the update are not included; sets unlocked after Relaying will be retained). Switching between unlocked sets on that gear will no longer consume free switch attempts or Echo Jade, allowing you to freely switch sets on the same piece of gear for different Paths and combat environments.

[p align="justify"]3. Optimized the acquisition experience of \[Base Gear]. Based on player preferences, the random rules for the initial affixes of newly unlocked Tier 100 gear have been adjusted as follows: Increased the drop rate of Gold Initial Affixes in all \[Initial Affix Libraries]; removed \[Min Formless Attack] from the \[Weapon - Initial Affix Library], while increasing the rates of \[Min Physical Attack] and \[Max Physical Attack]; removed \ from the \[Greaves & Bracers - Initial Affix Library], while increasing the rate of \. In addition to these affixes, drop rates for other affixes in the \[Initial Affix Library] have also been slightly adjusted. Please refer to in-game effects for specifics.

[p align="justify"]4. Optimized the \[Gear Tuning] and \[Gear Retuning] experience. In all Tier 100 \[Tuning Libraries], increased the appearance rates of \[Min Physical Attack], \[Max Physical Attack], and \[DMG/Stat Boost] Rare Affixes, while decreasing the rates of \[Min Attribute Attack] and \[Max Attribute Attack]. Other affix rates have also been slightly adjusted. The appearance rates of all retunable affixes across all tiers in the \[Retuning Library] have been balanced to equal rates.

[p align="justify"]5. Optimized the \[Gear Reset Tuning] and \[Gear Retuning Correction] experience. The cooldown for \[Reset Tuning] and \[Retuning Correction] on all gear has been reduced from 5 days to 3 days. Gear currently in cooldown will not be affected. Optimized cooldown notification rules: After the update, checking gear upon cooldown completion will only dismiss the red dot and animated reminder; the cooldown completion prompt will remain until dismissed manually or until the gear's status changes.

[p align="justify"]6. Optimized the \[Battle Build] experience to accommodate more customized builds and quick-switch needs. After this update, saving a build will additionally record \[Gear Attuning], \[Mystic Skill Enlightenment], and \ settings, allowing them to be switched simultaneously when changing builds. Previously, \[Gear Attuning] only recorded the attuning type; after the update, it will record the specific active Attuning Affixes. Activating historical attuning affixes consumes Echo Jade, and a prompt will notify you at that time.

[p align="justify"]7. Optimized the \[Character Leveling] catch-up experience. Characters between Lv. 96 and Lv. 99 will retain the Level Catch-up status, during which the character EXP gain rate is increased to 400%.

[p align="justify"]8. Optimized the \[Gear Progression] catch-up experience. For all gear below the current season's latest tier (Tier 100), the \[Aspiration Attribute] requirement for equipping has been standardized to 5 points, lowering the equip threshold for lower-tier gear.
General Experience Optimization

[p align="justify"]1. Adjusted the base effects of Inner Way \[Seasonal Edge]: Reduced the immediate Endurance recovery upon gaining \[Seasonal Edge: Spring], and added an effect that grants extra Endurance recovery on every hit during its duration. Reduced the damage reduction value of \[Seasonal Edge: Winter], and correspondingly reduced the Endurance consumption increase ratio when sprinting, jumping, and dodging. Added Tier 1 effect: Continuous hits that put Player Units into Hitstun or Control for a certain duration will reduce the effect's trigger interval.
[p align="justify"]2. \[Jianghu Journey - Arena - Training Terrace] now supports practice for \, \[Perception Forest], and \[Group Strategy] combat modes.
[p align="justify"]Bellstrike - Splendor

[p align="justify"]1. For Martial Art \[Nameless Sword], the talent \[Qi Struggle Enhancement] has been renamed to \[Base Damage Enhancement]. The damage calculation multiplier layer for its Sword Energy attack's 20% bonus damage against \[Non-Player Units] has been adjusted to align with other \[Bonus DMG against Specific Units] multipliers, no longer being diluted by general damage boost effects.

[p align="justify"]2. Adjusted the effect of the \ set: Increased the effect duration to 12s, aligning it with the effect activation interval. Synchronized the base effect of Inner Way \[Mountain's Might]: Increased the duration of \[Endless Gale] to 12s, aligning it with the \ set duration.

[p align="justify"]3. For Martial Art \[Nameless Spear], added a new mechanism to the \[Peerless Stance] status inflicted by Special Skill \[Legion Crusher]: During its duration, the charge speed of Charged Skill \[Vagrant Sword] of the same-Path Martial Art \[Nameless Sword] is also accelerated; the status is removed upon triggering. Adjusted the Tier 1 effect of Inner Way \[Mountain's Might]: Any Bellstrike - Splendor Martial Art skill now adds \[grants Peerless Stance to self on hitting Non-Boss Units] on top of the original \[inflicts Qi Imbalance on target on hitting Boss Units]. Added Tier 1 effect to Inner Way \[Sword Morph]: Under \[Peerless Stance], you can charge and release \[multiple Sword Energy] slashes without requiring a Qi Shield.
[p align="justify"]Bellstrike - Umbra

[p align="justify"]1. For Martial Art \[Strategic Sword], slightly advanced the skill cancel window of \[Zenith Sword] that can be chained after Special Skill \[Third Theorem], allowing subsequent combos to be executed more easily.
[p align="justify"]Silkbind - Jade

[p align="justify"]1. For Martial Art \[Inkwell Fan], adjusted the \ effect inflicted by Martial Art Skill \[Jadewind Shield]: The damage calculation multiplier layer for the 10% bonus damage dealt by projectile or heavy attack follow-up skills against \[Boss Units] has been adjusted to align with other \[Bonus DMG against Specific Units] multipliers, no longer being diluted by general damage boost effects.

[p align="justify"]2. For Martial Art \[Inkwell Fan], when Heavy Attack Follow-up Skill \[Moonlit Startle] hits a non-player enemy, it will directly enhance into \[Moonlit Startle: EX], significantly increasing its base damage (the original bonus damage against non-player enemies is merged into the base damage of \[Moonlit Startle: EX] with no additional multiplier). During the cast of \[Moonlit Startle], it can be interrupted at any time via the second stage of Special Skill \[Withered Peak] to blink back to the Water Clone.

[p align="justify"]3. For Martial Art \[Inkwell Fan], the talent \[Low-Qi Follow-up Boost] has been renamed to \[Heavy Attack Follow-up Boost]. When its Heavy Attack Follow-up Skill \[Moonlit Startle] hits \[Low-Qi Targets], the +30% Critical Rate effect has been adjusted to +15% Critical DMG, and the 5 extra Qi Damage per strike now only applies to \[Low-Qi Player Targets]. Added an effect: When \[Moonlit Startle] hits \[Non-Player Targets], it inflicts \[Empty Peak], increasing the Qi Damage taken from the applier by 5% and inflicting the \[Qi Anomaly] status during its duration.

[p align="justify"]4. Adjusted the base effects of Inner Way \[Thunderous Bloom]: The damage boost of \[Spring Thunder] on heavy attacks, heavy attack follow-ups, light attacks, and projectile skills has been changed from \[+15% HP Damage] to \[+10 Physical Penetration and +10 Silkbind Penetration]. Adjusted Tier 1 and Tier 4 effects: The original Tier 4 effect has been moved to Tier 1, and the new Tier 4 effect grants \[penetration values increased by an additional 10 points]. Added Tier 6 effect: Hitting targets afflicted with \[Qi Anomaly] will also restore 1 stack of \[Spring Thunder] (the \[Qi Anomaly] statuses include \[Qi Imbalance], \[Bone Corrosion], and \[Empty Peak]).

[p align="justify"]5. For Martial Art \[Vernal Umbrella], adjusted the projectile collision rules for Special Skill \[Unfading Flower]: It can now penetrate invisible walls in Multiplayer Dungeons and Arena mode.
[p align="justify"]Stonesplit - Might

[p align="justify"]1. For Martial Art \[Thundercry Blade], the talent \[Physical Attack Boost] has been renamed to \[Base Attribute Boost]. Its effect has been adjusted from granting additional Max Physical Attack based on the higher value between Constitution and Power to increasing Max Physical Attack when Power is higher, and increasing Physical Defense when Constitution is higher (increasing Max Physical Attack when Constitution and Power are equal), allowing players to adjust attribute orientation based on their needs.

[p align="justify"]2. For Martial Art \[Stormbreaker Spear], the talent \[Max HP Boost] has been renamed to \[Base Attribute Boost]. Its effect has been adjusted from granting additional Max HP based on the higher value between Constitution and Power to increasing Min Physical Attack when Power is higher, and increasing Max HP when Constitution is higher (increasing Min Physical Attack when Constitution and Power are equal), allowing players to adjust attribute orientation based on their needs.
[p align="justify"]Stonesplit - Strength

[p align="justify"]1. For Martial Art \[Snowparting Blade], adjusted the effect of talent \[Special Skill Boost]: The +12% HP damage taken during \ has been adjusted to a proportional increase in Physical Damage and Stonesplit Damage taken. In non-Arena modes, the duration of \ extended when \[General's Bane: Stab] hits multiplayer bosses has been adjusted from 6s to 10s.

[p align="justify"]2. For Martial Art \[Phalanxbane Blade], added a new effect to Martial Art Skill \[Soul Burning]: In non-Arena modes, while in Iron Guards status, tapping the skill again during a charge will unleash \[Total Annihilation: Soul], dealing damage equivalent to \[Total Annihilation: Supreme] and refreshing Iron Guards.

[p align="justify"]3. Adjusted Tier 4 effect of Inner Way \[Frost-Clad Night]: The Anxi Army Assist triggered by casting \[Snowbreak Spring] during Inner Passion now also gains a 40% damage boost against Non-Player Units. Adjusted Tier 6 effect: The cooldown of \ has been reduced from 6s to 5.5s.
[p align="justify"]Bamboocut - Wind

[p align="justify"]1. Added Tier 6 effect to Inner Way \[Echoes of Oblivion]: When Special Skill Stage 2 \[Greed Bane: Soul] hits in non-Arena environments, it will also trigger light attack on-hit effects.

[p align="justify"]2. For Martial Art \[Mortal Rope Dart], adjusted the effect of talent \[Bone Corrosion State Boost]: Martial Art Skill \[Bladebound Thread] and Varied Combo Skill \[Coiled Dragon] will inflict 5s/20s of \[Bone Corrosion] on players/non-players. Targets in the \[Bone Corrosion] state take 5%/2% increased Qi Damage from the applier, and light attacks deal an additional 40%/10% Qi Damage; if the target's Qi is below 40%, light attacks deal 5% increased HP Damage.
[p align="justify"]Bamboocut - Dust

[p align="justify"]1. For Martial Art \[Everspring Umbrella], adjusted the \[Fragrant Song] effect applied by talent \[Perfect Umbrella Catch Boost]: The damage calculation multiplier layer for its 20% bonus damage against \[Non-Player Units] has been adjusted to align with other \[Bonus DMG against Specific Units] multipliers, no longer being diluted by general damage boost effects.

[p align="justify"]2. Added Tier 3 effect to Inner Way \[Phantom Rally]: In non-Arena environments, when Special Skill \[Cyclone Waltz] hits a target afflicted with Phantom Chime, it can consume all Phantom Chime stacks to continuously boost the damage of Special Skill \[Cyclone Waltz] for a period based on the number of stacks consumed.
[p align="justify"]Bamboocut: Kite
[p align="justify"]1. For Martial Art \[Heavenwill Gauntlets], significantly accelerated the charge speed of Charged Skill \[Vile Condemned: End].

[p align="justify"]2. Adjusted Tier 4 effect of Inner Way \[Soaring High]: The \[Heaven's Will] refund for Charged Skill \[Vile Condemned: End] has been adjusted from at most once every 18s to once per cast. Added Tier 6 effect: Casting \[Vile Condemned: End] when \[Heaven's Will] reaches 4 bars increases the target's damage taken from your \[Vile Condemned: End] by 8% for 25s, stacking up to 2 times.
Arena Experience Optimization

[p align="justify"]1. Adjusted the maximum consecutive Deflection count for certain martial art skills to lower the threshold and optimize consecutive Deflection experience: \[Third Theorem] adjusted from max 4 to 3 times; \[Fleeting Trace] adjusted from max 9 to 5 times; \[Grave Frost] adjusted from max 4 to 3 times; \[Greed Bane] adjusted from max 6 to 3 times; the 3rd/4th/5th light attack hits of \[Heaven's Wrath] adjusted from max 8/5/5 to 3/3/3 times; \[Celestial Mandate] adjusted from max 4 to 3 times; \[All Under Justice] adjusted from max 4 to 3 times.

[p align="justify"]2. Improved the rotation tracking performance of the first light attack hit for all weapons; improved the displacement tracking performance of the first light attack hit for weapons \, \[Heng Blade], and \[Mo Blade].
[p align="justify"]3. Adjusted the backward dodge distance and skill cancel windows across all weapons to balance overall performance while retaining weapon identity.

[p align="justify"]4. In Arena mode, added extra Endurance consumption upon successfully charging certain martial art charged skills, including \[Drifting Thrust], \[Galecloud Cleave], \, \[Fury Spear], \[Burning Heart], \[Dreamwrought Bubbles], and \[Vile Condemned Series Skills].
[p align="justify"]5. For weapon \, accelerated the animation speed of Divine Counter's second strike: If the first strike hits an enemy, it can now consistently chain into the second strike.
[p align="justify"]6. Fixed an issue where the fourth light attack hit of weapon \ had a chance of missing the first strike when attacking enemies from the side or back.
[p align="justify"]7. For weapon \[Dual Blades], accelerated the overall animation speed of Dual-Weapon Skills.
[p align="justify"]8. For weapon \[Mo Blade], increased dodge distance and advanced skill cancel windows to close the dodge performance gap with other weapons.
[p align="justify"]9. For weapon \[Mo Blade], moderately accelerated the animation speed of Dual-Weapon Skills and improved rotation tracking performance.

[p align="justify"]10. For weapon \[Heng Blade], slightly increased the startup windup of the first light attack hit to align its performance with weapons \ and \[Dual Blades]. Following the adjustment, low-latency players will no longer be able to chain a light attack combo after \[Stygian Freeze].
[p align="justify"]11. For weapon \[Rope Dart], accelerated the animation speed of the first and second light attack hits, allowing the first hit to consistently chain into the second hit.

[p align="justify"]12. Adjusted the interrupt priority of Mystic Skill \[Cloud Steps]: \[Cloud Steps] can now interrupt most enemy Martial Art skills or Mystic Skills to align with standard Mystic Skills; meanwhile, appropriately increased the tracking elevation of \[Cloud Steps] in Arena mode.
[p align="justify"]13. For Martial Art \[Nameless Spear], adjusted the dash skill animation to unify with other \ weapon dash skills, improving overall performance.

[p align="justify"]14. Adjusted the prerequisite for Martial Art \[Nameless Spear] Skill \[Qiankun's Lock] to gain Endless Gale: After the adjustment, Endless Gale can only be gained when Martial Art \[Nameless Sword] is equipped simultaneously.
[p align="justify"]15. For Martial Art \[Nameless Spear], moderately increased the attack range of Charged Skill \[Storm Dance].
[p align="justify"]16. For Martial Art \[Strategic Sword], improved the rotation tracking performance of Martial Art Skill \[First Axiom] Stage 2.

[p align="justify"]17. For Martial Art \[Inkwell Fan], reduced the first-stage hit area and knockback distance of Special Skill \[Withered Peak]; additionally, added brief invulnerability when blinking back to the Water Clone via the second stage of Special Skill \[Withered Peak].

[p align="justify"]18. For Martial Art \[Panacea Fan], added a new mechanism to Martial Art Skill \[Cloudburst Healing]: The thrown fan deals 2 consecutive strikes to surrounding enemies; in Arena mode, this move can break the enemy's defensive stance.

[p align="justify"]19. For Martial Art \[Soulshade Umbrella], the charged skill \[Hidden Sword: Thrust] under Hidden Sword stance no longer consumes Dew, and its rotation tracking performance has been significantly improved.
[p align="justify"]20. Removed the Tenacity effect of Martial Art \[Willowbend Fan] Heavy Attack Varied Combo Skill \[End of Gale] in multiplayer Arena modes.
[p align="justify"]21. For Martial Art \[Thundercry Blade], increased the Stagger duration caused by Charged Skill \ to ensure more consistent follow-up combos.
[p align="justify"]22. Adjusted the timing for Martial Art \[Thundercry Blade] Special Skill \[Sunrush Gale] to gain Tenacity: Tenacity is now gained only when the airflow gathers.
[p align="justify"]23. For Martial Art \[Stormbreaker Spear], improved the rotation tracking performance of the first two thrusts of Charged Skill \[Fury Spear] to improve combo consistency.

[p align="justify"]24. For Martial Art \[Snowparting Blade], accelerated the overall animation speed of Light Attack Varied Combo Skill \[Stygian Freeze], allowing it to consistently chain into the light attack charged skill \[Grave Frost] under Forgetfulness status.

[p align="justify"]25. Except in \[Perception Forest] mode, removed the Stagger Protection mechanism when the final hit of \[Fleeting Trace] strikes an enemy, allowing it to chain into subsequent moves normally.

[p align="justify"]26. For Martial Art \[Snowparting Blade], advanced the skill cancel window of Martial Art Skill \[General's Bane], allowing for smoother transitions into \[General's Bane: Slash]; meanwhile, advanced the skill cancel window of \[General's Bane: Slash], allowing subsequent combos to be executed more reliably.
[p align="justify"]27. For Martial Art \[Infernal Twinblades], overall animation speed of Burst Skill \ has been accelerated.

[p align="justify"]28. For Martial Art \[Mortal Rope Dart], the HP recovery effect of Charged Skill \[Rodent's Resilience] is now subject to Healing Reduction restrictions in Arena mode; meanwhile, adjusted the timing of additional Endurance consumption for \[Rodent's Resilience]: changed from consuming immediately upon skill cast to consuming upon gaining Tenacity.

[p align="justify"]29. Adjusted the Attuning effect related to \[Special Skill: Legion Crusher]: reduced the Immobilize duration inflicted by \[Legion Crusher] on units with Tenacity; subsequent combos cannot be chained after the Immobilize effect ends.

[p align="justify"]30. Adjusted the skill priority of Charged Skill \[Dreamwrought Bubbles] for Martial Art \[Everspring Umbrella]: it can now be interrupted by dodging or other Martial Art skills to align with other standard charged skills; meanwhile, significantly accelerated the charging speed of \[Dreamwrought Bubbles], and increased the continuous Endurance consumption during charging.

[p align="justify"]31. For Martial Art \[Unfettered Rope Dart], the HP recovery effect of Charged Skill \[Piercing Dart] is now subject to Healing Reduction restrictions in Arena mode; meanwhile, slightly delayed the timing at which \[Piercing Dart] begins continuous Endurance consumption to align with Charged Skill \[Rodent's Resilience] of Martial Art \[Mortal Rope Dart].
[p align="justify"]32. For Martial Art \[Heavenwill Gauntlets], reduced the Stagger duration inflicted by the second stage of heavy attacks.

[p align="justify"]33. Adjusted the Passive Break Control effect of Mystic Skill \[Serene Breeze]: after a player breaks free from Hitstun, Control, or Silence, the decay rate of the Passive Break Control gauge is moderately slowed; meanwhile, casting \[Serene Breeze] at low altitude will significantly accelerate the landing speed.

[p align="justify"]34. Mystic Skill \[Golden Body] now grants a brief Tenacity effect during its startup animation; meanwhile, if \[Golden Body] is interrupted during startup, the shield and Qi recovery effects will not be granted.
[p align="justify"]35. Adjusted the skill priority of Mystic Skill \[Leaping Toad] after becoming airborne in the third stage: it can now only be interrupted by jumping.
Bug Fixes

[p align="justify"]1. Fixed an issue where the second stage of Martial Art Skill \[General's Bane: Stab] for Martial Art \[Snowparting Blade] failed to properly turn toward target units when untargeted.

[p align="justify"]2. Fixed an issue where Charged Skill \[Burning Heart] of Martial Art \[Phalanxbane Blade] could not be interrupted by dodging or other Martial Art skills during sustained charging.

[p align="justify"]3. Fixed an issue where the Formless Attack boosted by the Tier 2 effect of Inner Ways \[Celestial Vigor], \[Blade's Will], and \ had numerical inconsistencies with the Attribute Attack boosted by other Inner Ways of the same quality.
[p align="justify"]4. Fixed an issue where Charged Skill \[Vile Condemned] of Martial Art \[Heavenwill Gauntlets] could not deal damage to human walls and geese.
Guild War Experience Optimization

[p align="justify"]1. Adjusted the casting effect of Skill \[Heavenquaker Spear: EX]: the effect at Lv. 3 where the final hit extends Super Armor has been changed to inflicting 5 additional stacks of the \[Soul-Shaken] effect on hit enemy units.

[p align="justify"]2. Adjusted the casting effect of Skill \[Panacea Fan: EX]: after casting, the healing duration per level has been increased from 6/6.3/6.3/6.9/6.9s to 9/10/10/12/12s, with total healing increased to 120%/125%/125%/139%/139% of the original. However, when a unit receives healing from this skill from three different sources within 60s, this skill's healing effectiveness is reduced by 60%; for four or more sources, it is reduced by 80%.

[p align="justify"]3. Enhanced the casting effect of Skill \[Inkwell Fan: EX]: at Lv. 3, the \ effect inflicted on enemies within the wind field not only reduces the target's Vitality recovery rate by 90%, but also increases damage dealt to them by 15% from units carrying the \[Build Momentum] effect granted by Skill \[Vernal Umbrella: EX].

[p align="justify"]4. Enhanced the casting effect of Skill \[Stormbreaker Spear: EX]: after casting, it additionally deals damage and applies a strong pull effect to enemies within an 11-meter radius.

[p align="justify"]5. Enhanced the casting effect of Skill \[Everspring Umbrella: EX]: after casting, it also increases damage dealt by \[Scarlet Spin] to enemies by 20% for the next 15 seconds and inflicts a corresponding level of Healing Reduction.
[p align="justify"]6. Adjusted the casting effect of Skill \[Museflow Waist Drum: EX]: at Lv. 3, the Silence effect inflicted on units with \[Ink Rhythm] can now be dispelled by Break Control skills.
Perception Forest Experience Optimization

[p align="justify"]1. Added new effect to Inner Way \[Heavenquaker Spear]: during the cast of Martial Art Skill \[Sober Sorrow] of Martial Art \[Heavenquaker Spear], grants self Tenacity and 60% damage reduction.
[p align="justify"]2. Added new effect to Inner Way \[Unfettered Rope Dart]: casting Special Skill \[Burn and Bury] of Martial Art \[Unfettered Rope Dart] restores 1 \[Token of Gratitude] to self.

[p align="justify"]3. Added new effect to Inner Way \[Phalanxbane Blade]: accelerates the time required for Martial Art Skill \[Soul Burning] of Martial Art \[Phalanxbane Blade] to enter the enhanced state, and increases the damage dealt by \[Soul Burning] by 50%.
[p align="justify"]4. Added new effect to Inner Way \[Raging Waves]: upon equipping, grants a base effect of +10 Physical Attack.

[p align="justify"]5. Optimized the effect of Inner Way \[Twilight Rage]: adjusted the HP threshold check to 70% of Max HP; when current HP is above 70%, Physical Attack increases by 10%; when current HP is at or below 70%, damage taken is reduced by 10%.

[p align="justify"]6. Optimized the effect of Inner Way \[Snowprint Step]: hitting an enemy with \[Cloud Steps] refunds 1 Charge and grants an HP Shield equal to 25% of Max HP for 10s (this effect can only trigger once every 10s). While the shield is active, for every surviving enemy within 5 meters, damage taken by self is reduced by an additional 2%.

[p align="justify"]7. Adjusted the effect of Inner Way \[Heal - Rare]: fixed an issue where the Healing Bonus provided by the Inner Way did not match its description, and adjusted its calculation multiplier layer; its 18% Healing Bonus has been adjusted to a 30% healing boost effect, which aligns with the calculation multiplier layer of the \[Healing Boost Effect] from \[Divinecraft - Water].

[p align="justify"]8. Optimized Mystic Skill \[Shattered Form]: slightly accelerated the animation and damage delivery speed after transformation; on hit, it now also inflicts Silence for 6s, during which Mystic Skills cannot be used.

[p align="justify"]9. Optimized Mystic Skill \[Fiery Kite]: expanded the fire zone area created after casting and extended the duration during which \[Cloud Steps] cannot be used while inside the fire zone; traversing the fire zone now also inflicts a 3s Immobilize effect once.

[p align="justify"]10. Adjusted Mystic Skill \[Guardian Palm]: when \[Guardian's Beacon] is cast from above a certain height, its damage increase effect now has a cap; added a Tenacity-Break effect, allowing it to still knock down targets with Tenacity on hit.
[p align="justify"]11. Optimized Mystic Skill \: increased base damage by 20%; on hitting a target, additionally inflicts a 70% Healing Reduction effect for 7s.
October 29, 2026 Fixes and Optimizations
[p align="justify"]1. Fixed an issue where the accessory set \[Autumn Eve Whimsy] could not be equipped after purchase and caused the Wardrobe to function abnormally.
[p align="justify"]2. Fixed an issue where the accessory set \[Autumn Eve Whimsy] was missing from the Shop for certain Wanderers.
[p align="justify"]3. Fixed a display issue where the hairstyle \[Pristine Grace] appeared incorrectly when equipped.
[p align="justify"]4. Optimized the activation conditions for certain Guild Techniques.
[p align="justify"]5. Fixed an issue where Calligraphy Treasure settings for the Mystic Skill \[Inkwash Splendor] could not be saved.
[p align="justify"]6. Fixed an issue on PS5 that prevented Wanderers from completing dialogues during the Campaign \[Mount Tai Blizzard].

[p align="justify"]Dear Wanderers,

Ahead of the Version 2.3 update, we adjusted the in-game time display and offset system to improve the experience for players across different regions. However, a code merge conflict caused the time offset system to fail across the Yunya region (Europe and Middle East servers), Yougu region (US East and South America servers), and Linhe region (US West servers). This caused Guild War to open ahead of schedule in these regions. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience and frustration this issue has caused.

The issue first occurred on October 18 at 03:30 (UTC+8) during the day's first Guild War match, and a technical fix was completed on October 18 at 21:00 (UTC+8). Since matches were still underway in the Canglang region at that time, deployment was postponed until after those matches concluded to avoid disrupting ongoing games. The deployment was finalized on October 18 at 23:55 (UTC+8), after which Guild War resumed its normal schedule.

Because this anomaly prevented certain guilds from participating normally, we have rolled back all Guild War scores accumulated during the abnormal opening period to ensure competitive fairness. Compensation has also been sent to affected Wanderers.
Moving forward, we will refine our internal workflows and reinforce verification during code merging and release phases to prevent similar issues from happening again.
Additionally, with certain regions transitioning from Daylight Saving Time to Standard Time starting October 25, we have received inquiries from Wanderers regarding Guild War start times.

Since the European and American regions cover multiple countries with varying daylight saving practices and schedules, Guild War start times will not adjust with regional daylight saving transitions. This ensures consistent and stable event timing across each region, and matches will continue to open according to current set server times.

As a result, the local start time for Guild War in certain regions may shift by one hour once local clocks transition to Standard Time. Please check the in-game event interface to confirm your local schedule and plan your participation accordingly.
The optimizations and bug fixes for the October 29 update are as follows:
1. The end time for Battle Pass \[Scarlet Whispers] has been adjusted from November 14 at 04:59:59 to November 13 at 17:59:59 (UTC+8).
Starting October 29, the reset time for the weekly Battle Pass EXP cap has been adjusted to every Monday at 05:00:00 (UTC+8).
We will be retroactively granting Battle Pass EXP to all Wanderers on all servers. Thank you for your understanding and support.
2. Added support for the \ region. Wanderers can now purchase the required items at \[Zhao Laoliu’s General Store].
3. Fixed an issue where certain mail rewards could not be re-claimed, causing the mails to be unable to be deleted.
4. Fixed an issue where certain Qinghe Homestead quests could not be completed.
5. Fixed an issue where the titles \[Blooming Rebuttal], \[Unrivaled Cardmaster], and \[Cast the Cosmos] could not be activated or used after being acquired.
September 16 Patch Notes (Version 2.2)

Eastwind Pavilion will have a rolling maintenance update on September 16, 2026, from 5:00 to 10:00 (UTC+8). During this time, you'll still be able to log in and play, but some features and modes might be temporarily unavailable. The update schedule could change depending on the situation, so please plan your gaming accordingly. Thanks so much for your understanding and support!
Below is the new version intel brought for you from the Eastwind Pavilion. Check it out!
Guild Improvements
1. The Guild Roster homepage is now editable. Guild Management can pin selected members to the top, while other members are sorted by their activity from the previous week.

2. Guild War now includes personal and guild seasonal statistics, letting you clearly view league and matchmaking data for each season. This is currently available starting from the new season. Data from past seasons will be made available for review in a future update.

[p align="justify"]Greetings, Wanderers,
[p align="justify"]

[p align="justify"]We've noticed that some of you are experiencing high latency and poor performance during cross-server matches in the Arena. To address this, we will be optimizing our matchmaking rules this week. Here are the details:
[p align="justify"]
1. Priority Matching Within Your Battlegroup

[p align="justify"]The system will now prioritize matching you with other players from your own server within the same Battlegroup. This is intended to reduce latency and improve match stability. If a suitable opponent isn't found on your server, the search will then expand to other servers within your Battlegroup.
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]For example: HK/Macau/Taiwan server players will be matched with HK/Macau/Taiwan players first; US East with US East; US West with US West.
[p align="justify"]
2. Server Assignment for Cross-Region Matches

[p align="justify"]If your physical location is different from your selected Battlegroup's region (e.g., an Asian player choosing a US Battlegroup) and you are matched with a US player, the match will be hosted on the US player's server.
[p align="justify"]

[p align="justify"]We will continue to closely monitor latency and optimize the matchmaking experience. We encourage all Wanderers to report any lag or stuttering you encounter via our official channels. Tackling latency is a long-term commitment, but we are dedicated to making steady progress. Thank you for your understanding and support.

notes.title: Here are the details of the upcoming optimizations

items.text: Ⅰ. "Relaying" & "Modulating"
1. "Relaying": Inheriting attributes from low to high-tier gear.

"Relaying Stone: Vanguard" can transform Tier 86 non-retroactive "Gear" into Tier 91 "Relaid Gear". "Relaying Stone: Vanguard" can be obtained through Solo Mode level breakthroughs, Season Shop, and Engagement Realm rewards. "Relaying" brings the following enhancements: the gear is upgrade to Tier 91 (cannot be put in the Tier 86 Arsenal anymore), together with boost to base attributes and 2-piece effects; set types and Attuning attribute type & value retains (including historical Attuning attributes), with increased attribute cap; switch and "Re-attuning" are unlocked; and initial and Tuned attributes retain their types and values while gaining higher potential caps.
2. "Modulating": Specialized boost to inherited attributes for Relaid Gear.

"Relaid Gear" can only be enhanced via "Modulating", instead of "Tuning" or "Retuning." Before "Modulating", select a specific attribute and consume one Legendary Tier 91 gear with completed tuning to increase that attribute's value. The increase depends solely on how well the attributes match, regardless of quality. After "Relaying," "Gear Echo: Vanguard" and "Tuning Stone: Vanguard" equivalent to the recycled price of the Legendary gear will be returned. All "Relaid Gear" attributes can be raised to a fixed cap through "Modulating" (slightly lower than standard Tier 91 gear), independent of their pre-Relaying values.
3. Attribute Inheritance for Same-Tier Gear.

In the upcoming season, "Relaying Stone: Vanguard" can not only convert Tier 86 non-retroactive "Gear" into Tier 91 "Relaid Gear", but also turn eligible Tier 91 "Gear" into "Relaid Gear." This preserves the gear tier, basic attributes, set, and Attuning attributes while unlocking "Modulating" development, with the same cap as other "Relaid Gear." Any Tuning values exceeding the Modulating cap will be removed upon conversion.
After the update, you can check the Gear Relaying interface for more information.
Ⅱ. Gear Tuning & Retuning Optimizations
1. Easier Tuning Material Acquisition: "Legendary Melodic Stone" of all tiers can now be obtained through "Craft," consuming 3 "Epic Melodic Stones" of the same tier.
2. More Tuning Materials Offered: In any "Energy" Challenge modes, every 60 "Energy" consumed grants one additional random-quality "Melodic Stone."

3. Optimized Initial Attributes for Tier 91 "Defense" Gear: We have lowered the drop probability for "Max HP", "Physical Defense", and "Body", and increased the probability for "Precision Rate", "Critical Rate", "Affinity Rate", and "Power" based on player preferences.

4. Optimized Tuning Attributes: The "All Martial Arts Boost" attribute in the "Ring/Amulet - Tuning Library" of all tiers has been renamed to "All Martial Arts Enhancement," making it effective for healing paths; "Fan Martial Arts DMG Boost/Healing Boost" and "Umbrella Martial Arts DMG Boost/Healing Boost" in the Tier 91 "Weapon - Attuning Library" will be replaced by "Art of Fan Boost" and "Art of Umbrella Boost" to boost both damage and healing simultaneously.
5. Lower Tuning Cost: Tier 91 Gear Tuning costs fewer coins, allowing for more Tuning attempts and less coin pressure.
6. "Tuning - Quick Add" Function: You can intelligently select materials based on the optimal "Tuning Stone" combination, and only materials and gear are sorted.

7. "Retuning Correction": You can use "Retuning Stone: Vanguard" to Retune a Retuned attribute again for Tier 91 non-Relaid Gear. The system will exclude the current result from the library to ensure a new attribute is rolled. Retuning Correction has a 7-day cooldown, with no limit on total uses.
8. Tuning Attribute Downsizing: All "Minimum Attribute Attack" attributes have been removed from the "Retuning Library" of all tiers, and every path now has a standard library of 6 attributes.
9. "Result Preview": The "Preview" button allows you to view the entire library after selecting the "Retuning Library" or "Re-attuning Library", with unavailable attributes dimmed for better clarity.
Ⅲ. Gear Attuning & Re-attuning Optimizations

1. Optimized Attuning Attributes: "Bellstrike Penetration", "Stonesplit Penetration," "Silkbind Penetration," and "Bamboocut Penetration" in Tier 91 "Offensive Gear - Attuning Library" will be replaced with "Formless Penetration," which automatically adapts to your current Martial Art and enhances corresponding "Attribute Penetration". This ensures that the attribute remains valuable even after using Dual-Weapon Skill.

2. Re-attuning Guarantee System: Tier 91 gear now features a "guarantee" counter. After a set number of Re-attuning, you will gain a "Custom Re-attuning" opportunity, allowing you to choose your desired attribute type for free (the attribute values will still be generated randomly according to standard Re-attuning rules). "Normal Attuning" and "Arena Attunement" have separate counters. Additionally, rolling a duplicate attribute will now provide a more stable and guaranteed value increase.

3. Attuning Swap: By spending a small amount of "Attunement Stones" and "Re-attunement Stones," you can completely exchange the "Normal Attunement" or "Arena Attunement" of a Tier 91 Attuned gear with another Attuned piece of the exact same tier and gear slot. This swap transfers all Attuning attributes of the chosen type, perfectly mirroring them, including the gear's Historical Attuning and Re-attunement guarantee counters.
Ⅳ. Archery Jade Crafting Optimization
Optimized Guarantee System for Tier 91 Legendary Archery Jades: You can now navigate directly to the Craft interface to clearly view their remaining attempts until a guaranteed drop.

Enhanced Crafting Yields for Tier 91 Epic/Legendary Archery Jades: We are introducing three new "2-piece" bonuses. These include the "Plume" set (increases Precision Rate), the "Startling String" set (increases Critical Rate), and the "Pursuing Shadow" set (increases Affinity Rate). These set bonuses require no deep development or investment to unlock; simply equipping two Archery Jade pieces from the identical set will activate the effects immediately.

We hope these optimizations will provide our Rangers with a significantly improved gear development experience. Please keep an eye on future update announcements for even more detailed optimization notes.
Ⅴ. Preview of Pacing Adjustments for Gear Development
To further alleviate the pressure of gear grinding and optimize the seasonal growth experience, future updates to level caps and gear tiers will be synchronized with full-season cycles.
April 30 Update (Start of Season 3, First Half): "Lv.14" is unlocked for Solo Mode, and Character Level cap raises to Lv.95, along with Tier 91 Gear.

Start of Season 3, Second Half: No new level caps or higher-tier gear will be introduced. During this phase, "Lv.15" is unlocked for Solo Mode (providing slight character attribute increases), new levels for "Gear Enhancement" will unlock, and Seasonal "Talents" will receive an update. There will also be a wealth of brand-new gameplay content for Wanderers to explore. However, the character level cap will firmly remain at Lv.95, and Tier 91 gear will continue to be the standard. This adjustment is explicitly designed to resolve the issues of gear lifespans being too short and version shifts occurring too rapidly, ultimately delivering a more stable and relaxing development experience.
For exact schedules, please pay close attention to subsequent official announcements. As always, we warmly welcome all Wanderers to leave their valuable suggestions and feedback.

releases.displayName: April 30 Update: Arena & Guild War Optimization Overview

items.text: With the journey to Qinchuan approaching, Eastwind Pavilion presents key optimization updates.
To improve the network environment and competitive experience, the following optimizations for Arena and Guild War will be implemented in the April 30 update:
[p align="justify"]
Ⅰ. Arena Mode & Matchmaking Optimization
[p align="justify"]
1. New Arena Battlegroup Divisions
The system will now divide the Arena Mode into four regional battlegroups based on server locations:
Yougu: US East and US West servers;
Yunya: European servers;
Canglang: Asia and HK/MO/TW servers;
Jiangzhu: Southeast Asia servers.

\[Battlegroup Interoperability Rules]: Wanderers within the same Battlegroup share matchmaking pools and leaderboards. Event start times for time-limited Arena modes will be synchronized within each battlegroup. Matchmaking pools between different battlegroups remain independent.
[p align="justify"]
2. Smart Allocation & Manual Switching

notes.title: We will offer both smart allocation and manual switching

items.text: Smart Allocation: Upon the new season launch or feature update, the system will automatically assign you to a battlegroup based on your primary login server.
Manual Switching: Players may manually switch battlegroups via the Arena interface.
Costs & Rules: The first switch per half-season is free. The second switch costs Echo Jade ×100, with costs increasing for subsequent switches.

Impact: To ensure fair competition, switching battlegroups will reset your current Rank Points and remove you from your previous battlegroup's leaderboard. Claimed rank rewards will be retained and cannot be reclaimed by switching battlegroups.
[p align="justify"]
3. Exclusive Battlegroup Leaderboards
Arena leaderboards will be categorized by battlegroup. Each battlegroup will have independent rankings and season settlements.
A Battlegroup Filter has been added to the leaderboard UI for easier viewing.
[p align="justify"]
4. Mythic Rank Matchmaking Optimization

As our top-tier players continue to climb the ranks, we've noticed that matchmaking quality in high-level lobbies hasn't always met expectations. To address this, we are further optimizing our matchmaking system:

For the highest rank, Mythic, we are introducing score-based weighting to ensure players are matched with opponents of similar skill levels. This change aims to provide a more balanced and competitive experience at the top of the ladder. Please note that these optimizations may lead to slightly longer queue times. Thank you for your continued support and understanding.
[p align="justify"]
Ⅱ. Arena Mode Schedule Adjustments
[p align="justify"]

To better accommodate players across different time zones, we are adjusting the opening hours for certain Arena modes in coordination with the Arena Battlegroup system. Our goal is to ensure more Wanderers can participate at peak local times.
Please note that Arena matchmaking will be suspended 2 hours before and 1 hour after a mid-season or full-season transition.
Now open 24 hours a day. Wanderers can jump into the fray at any time.
15:00 to 02:00 (next day) local Battlegroup time every Monday, Wednesday, Friday, and Sunday.
12:00 to 02:00 (next day) local Battlegroup time daily.
(Note: Due to global time zone differences, actual start times may vary slightly. Please refer to the in-game schedule panel for the most accurate information.)

Ⅲ. Battlegroup Optimizations & Adjustments

Linhe: US West server
Jiangzhu: Southeast Asia server
[p align="justify"]

Yougu (US East Server): Sat & Sun @ 20:30 (UTC-4)

(Note: Due to global time zone differences, actual start times may vary slightly. Please refer to the in-game schedule panel for the most accurate information.)
[p align="justify"]

In addition to these updates, the new Group Strategy and Training Terrace modes are now live! Players can now enjoy multiplayer tactical combat and custom duel rooms. We hope these changes improve your multiplayer experience. Stay tuned for further update announcements.
Dear Wanderers,

[p align="justify"]Eastwind Pavilion will have a rolling maintenance update on Thursday, April 16, 2026, from 01:00 PM to 05:00 PM (UTC+8). During this time, you'll still be able to log in and play, but some features and modes might be temporarily unavailable. The update schedule could change depending on the situation. Thanks so much for your understanding and support!
[p align="justify"]Below are the latest news and improvements from Eastwind Pavilion. Check them out!
[p align="justify"]Experience Optimization
[p align="justify"]1. Added a new server in the US West region to improve network connection quality, providing a more stable and fluid gaming environment for our players there.

[p align="justify"]2. Improved the visual display of in-game fonts. We are rolling this out as a small-scale test exclusively on the PS5 platform first, so only a select group of PS5 Wanderers will experience this change early on. We welcome those with testing access to share their feedback and suggestions! We will gradually refine and expand this feature based on the test results.
[p align="justify"]3. Streamlined the new player tutorial process.
[p align="justify"]We've adjusted the unlock timing for certain tutorials and events, optimized the notification (red dot) rules during the early game, and refined the beginner combat tutorials.
[p align="justify"]4. Improved the instructional text for gameplays like Mahjong and Madiao Cards.
[p align="justify"]5. Clarified the description text for tuning rules.

[p align="justify"]1. Button conflict resolution: Added independent Interact/Pick Up/Talk button binding options in the settings specifically for Hero's Realm and Sword Trial. By default, these match your Open World settings, but you can now assign dedicated buttons based on your personal preference to effectively prevent misclicks during intense combat.

As the winds rise, may you roam freely and joyfully through this martial realm!

items.text: It has always been thrilling for us to see you leave the bamboo abode and embark on your journey into the world of Jianghu in Where Winds Meet. Just like your first encounter with Jianghu, our initial attempt to connect with players around the globe has been both exciting and uncertain. But our passion and commitment to creating a living open world drive us forward, and your response and support to our efforts has been a tremendous encouragement, giving us the confidence to keep pushing ahead.

Since launch, we have been listening closely. Your feedback, suggestions, frustrations, and encouragement have all been taken to heart, and we are actively addressing any areas where the experience has fallen short. While there is still much work to be done, we kindly ask for your patience as we continue to develop this world together with you.

Actions speak louder than words. To address the current issues affecting your experience, our development team is working tirelessly to optimize these concerns. Here are the initial progress we have made:

For network connectivity, we've fixed the routing issue that caused some players in Europe, the Middle East, and certain regions to be connected to non-local servers, resulting in high latency. We will continue to monitor post-fix data and player reports to ensure optimal performance.
The issue of high network latency in Online mode has been resolved, and the issue in Solo mode is expected to be fixed in the mid-December update.

Regarding text localization and voiceovers, we've revised many translations to make them more idiomatic and easier to understand. Additionally, we've optimized dubbing and subtitles in various story quests. We will continue to refine the localization of the game to make the Jianghu more immersive.
In terms of the interface, we've improved the beginner tutorial, enhanced character customization, and refined English clues for puzzle-solving quests.
These are just some examples of the key optimizations. For more details on fixes and improvements, please stay tuned for our official announcements.
Looking ahead, we're committed to ongoing improvements in other key issues that concern you most including text localization, PS5 compatibility, and multi-character creation features.

Optimizing multilingual localization is a continuous effort, and we’ve received many impressive translation suggestions through our open channels. We plan to launch co-creation events in the future, allowing your voice to shape the world of Where Winds Meet.
